description: Searches USCIS newsroom alerts and Federal Register notices by keyword, newest first. Use it to find announcements about a form or topic, e.g. "I-765" or "fee". To list everything published since a date without a keyword, use list_form_changes, which is free. Returns at most 100 matches per page. Pass next_cursor as cursor to continue until next_cursor is null. No match returns an empty list, not an error. Requires sign-in at https://immigrationlayer.com/login and an active plan. Without a plan it returns subscription_required. Limit: 30 calls per minute per account, shared by all paid tools, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Sources: USCIS newsroom alerts and Federal Register notices. The top-level source URL identifies the exact aggregate query, including the page cursor; each result preserves its government URL, source, and content hash.

cursor.description: Opaque navigation cursor from the preceding page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Keyword matched case-insensitively anywhere in an alert's title. A form number such as "I-765" also matches alerts tagged with that form. Summaries are not searched

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. "2026-08-01" or "2026-08-01T09:30:00Z"; limits results to alerts published on or after this instant. A date means midnight UTC; a date-time without an offset is UTC.

name: search_alerts

title.example: USCIS to publish new editions of Form I-539 and Form I-765

next_cursor.description: Pass this cursor to read the next page. Null means no more matches.
